A Chinese character integrates form, pronunciation, and meaning. Generally,the form of
a character reveals clues about its pronunciation and meaning. For example: in “材", the
component “7”indicates the pronunciation, and the radical“”(muzipong) suggests a
relation to wood; in “花", “化" indicates the pronunciation, and the radical “++” (coozitou)
implies a relation to plants and flowers.
